{{CorrectTitle|title=Imperial Communique #46553.28v|reason=#}}
'''Imperial Communique #46553.28v''' was an internal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] message from [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Solistein]], [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in response to [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Herrit]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Imperial Communique 46553.27h|message]] concerning the credentials of [[sentientologist]] [[Obo Rin]] and his ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]''.
